content: {"summary":"Users report frequent playback glitches, such as podcasts restarting mid‑episode and resetting to the beginning, causing them to lose track of progress [#rv_-2625762801862404443, #rv_-5074057797579201876, #rv_-2259083489306530995]. The app’s UI is criticized for unintuitive controls, with the play button often unresponsive and the notification banner disappearing, leaving no way to pause or skip [#rv_1068983455014319594, #rv_-3159312576296994856]. Many complain about unwanted podcast recommendations and cluttered home screens that push unrelated content, detracting from the music experience [#rv_327593664310295158, #rv_1445099924151836756, #rv_4003958690389864362]."}
